class A {
  protected x = 1;
}
class B extends A {
  viaUnion(other: A | B) {
    return other.x;
  }
  viaBaseConstraint<T extends A>(other: T) {
    return other.x;
  }
  viaDerivedUnion(other: B | C) {
    return other.x;
  }
  viaConstraint<T extends B>(other: T) {
    return other.x;
  }
  viaNestedConstraint<T extends U, U extends B>(other: T) {
    return other.x;
  }
  viaOptional(other?: B) {
    return other?.x;
  }
  viaIntersection(other: B & { y: number }) {
    return other.x;
  }
  viaNarrowing(other: A) {
    return other instanceof B ? other.x : 0;
  }
}
class C extends B {}
console.log(new B().viaConstraint(new C()));
